frame: Extreme close-up in blue pre-dawn darkness: a rough hemp rope running over the worn, rope-grooved stone lip of a courtyard cistern; a wooden bucket just disappearing into black water below
motion: The rope slides slowly over the stone lip, the bucket drops out of frame, a ripple of dark water. Static camera.
sfx: rope creaking on stone, a wooden bucket slapping into deep water, a distant rooster, pre-dawn hush

frame: Close-up from above of Timokles lying on a straw pallet under a wool blanket in a dim plastered room, eyes open, listening; faint blue light from a high small window
motion: He blinks, turns his head toward the wall as if listening. Very slow push in.
sfx: the dull rhythmic knock of a wooden loom through the wall, a donkey braying next door

frame: Medium shot in a small stone-paved courtyard at grey dawn: old Manes, bare-chested in a leather apron, hauling a dripping bucket from a round cistern mouth; Timokles in his chiton reaching to take the rope from him
motion: Timokles takes the rope from Manes without a word and hauls the bucket up himself; Manes steps back, rubbing his shoulder. Gentle handheld.
sfx: water sloshing, bare feet on stone, a breath of effort

frame: From behind: old Damagoras seated on a stool in the open street doorway of a plastered house, facing east down a straight grid street of tile-roofed houses; grey sky; Timokles sitting down on the threshold beside him with a piece of bread
motion: Timokles sits; the old man lifts one hand slightly, asking him to wait. Static.
sfx: distant dogs, a cart far off

lines.text: Wait.

frame: Close two-shot of the old man and the young man in profile, faces still in cool grey shadow, both looking up and slightly left at something above frame; the first warm golden light is just touching the old man's forehead
motion: Warm gold light slides slowly down across both faces as if reflected from something enormous and high out of frame; the old man's eyes glisten. Camera holds.
sfx: a single swallow, the hush breaking, one distant voice calling a greeting

frame: Wide view over terracotta tile roofs of an ancient Greek grid city at dawn, rooftops still in blue shadow; at the very top edge of the frame, cropped off, only the curve of an immense bronze knee and shin catching brilliant gold sunrise light, far off and hazy
motion: Gold light crawls slowly down the cropped bronze shin while the roofs below stay blue. Imperceptible drift.
sfx: wind, swallows

lines.text: Seventy cubits. Twelve years, I watched him go up. I was grey when they finished.
[gently] I know, Father.

frame: Insert: a dull brown unpolished bronze breastplate hanging on a peg on a plastered interior wall beside a doorway; an old man's heavy hand coming into frame to touch it
motion: The old hand rests on the breastplate for a beat, then withdraws as he leaves. Static.
sfx: the faint dull ring of fingers on bronze

lines.text: The city keeps its promises.

text: IN THE PRIESTHOOD OF THE SUN

frame: Wide shot outside a city wall in morning haze: two domed brick kilns smoking, rows of tall narrow two-handled unfired clay wine amphorae drying in the sun on the ground, clay pits, a few workers
motion: Smoke drifts from the kilns across the rows of jars. Slow lateral dolly.
sfx: kiln roar, crackling wood, a potter's wheel turning, birds

frame: Macro close-up: a young man's clay-stained fingers pressing a small rectangular bronze stamp into the soft top of a clay amphora handle; beside it an already stamped handle showing a tiny radiate sun-face and Greek letters
motion: The fingers press the stamp down and lift it away, revealing a crisp impression of a radiate sun face. Static macro.
sfx: soft wet press of clay

frame: Medium two-shot in an open-sided workshop shed: Timokles at a bench of unfired amphorae stamping handles; behind him old Manes wedging a lump of clay on a wooden bench, bare-chested, forearms scarred
motion: Timokles stamps a handle quickly and carelessly; Manes glances over without stopping his kneading. Slow push in.
sfx: thump of clay being wedged

lines.text: Crooked. And the harbour clerk says we're cheats.
Nobody reads the stamps, Manes.

frame: Close-up of Manes kneading clay, not looking up, a faint dry smile, soft light through the shed's reed roof
motion: He keeps kneading, then looks up at the boy with amused eyes. Static.
sfx: clay thumping

lines.text: Somebody always reads them. In a hundred years some fool will pick up your handle and say: this boy couldn't press a stamp straight.
[laughs]

frame: Top-down insert: a wicker basket half full of dozens of small old bronze stamps, dull green; a hand dropping one more in
motion: The bronze stamp drops into the basket and settles among the others. Static.
sfx: a small clink of bronze on bronze

frame: Extreme wide establishing shot of a great ancient Greek commercial harbour at midday: broad-hulled grain merchant ships with square sails moored three deep along stone moles, dockworkers carrying sacks, amphorae stacked on the quay, dust of wheat glittering in hard sunlight, city walls and tile roofs beyond, hazy
motion: Sails flap, workers stream across the quay, dust hangs in the light. Slow crane down.
sfx: harbour roar: shouting in Greek, gulls, creaking ropes and hulls, sacks thudding

frame: Tracking shot through a crowded quay: Manes leading a donkey cart loaded with straw-packed amphorae, Timokles walking beside it; in the background tax-farmers weighing goods on a big bronze balance at a table
motion: Camera tracks alongside the cart as it pushes through the crowd.
sfx: cart wheels on stone, a clerk calling out weights

frame: Medium close-up of a heavy sunburnt Rhodian merchant in a salt-stained himation on the quay, jabbing a finger, furious; over-shoulder of Timokles in soft focus foreground
motion: The merchant gestures angrily, then spits to one side. Handheld.
sfx: gulls, harbour noise

lines.text: Storm off Crete. Three hundred jars of oil over the side. Not mine! But the law says I pay my share.
[grudging] What's thrown over for all is made good by all. It's fair. I hate it.

frame: Close-up of Timokles on the bright quay, the noise around him, his expression going still and inward, thinking
motion: The crowd blurs past behind him; he holds still. Slow push.
sfx: harbour noise dips away to a hush, a faint ring of bronze

frame: Macro insert: heavy silver Rhodian tetradrachm coins poured into a clay-stained open palm; the top coin shows a facing head of the sun god with radiate hair
motion: Coins tumble into the palm and settle, the sun face catching light. Static.
sfx: coins clinking

frame: Low-angle two-shot: Lysistratos sitting on a sun-baked stone harbour wall eating a raw onion, grinning down at Timokles; behind them the dark prows of warships in long roofed shipsheds and a guard with a spear
motion: Lysistratos bites the onion and points at Timokles with it; Timokles shades his eyes to look up at him. Static.
sfx: water lapping, a guard's footsteps

lines.text: Ten days. Pirate patrol, down to Karpathos. You're on my bench.
My mother says eat properly first. You look like an oar.
Your mother is the finest woman in the city.

frame: Two young men wrestling in a sandy palaestra, bodies oiled and dusty, afternoon sun, colonnade behind
motion: Slow-motion grapple, sand spraying, oil glinting, one throws the other. Low camera.
sfx: grunts, sand, breath, slowed

frame: Wide shot from the shade of a stone colonnade high on a hill: two young men lying on their backs scraping oil off with bronze strigils; beyond them the whole ancient grid city falls away to two harbours and a dark blue sea, mountains of Asia Minor blue on the horizon
motion: Heat shimmer over the city; one lazily scrapes his arm. Very slow push.
sfx: cicadas, distant city murmur

lines.text: Run at the Games this year.
Too slow.
Too lazy.

frame: Profile close-up of Timokles lying in the colonnade shade, looking out at the sea, dust on his cheek, thinking
motion: He almost smiles; a breeze moves his hair. Static.
sfx: cicadas

lines.text: If I won, they'd put my name on a stone.
In the priesthood of whoever. And every jar your father made that year, you'd know.

frame: Dreamlike wide shot: a four-horse bronze-fitted racing chariot, garlanded with white poplar leaves, plunging off a rocky shore into a bright blue sea, spray exploding, golden light
motion: Slow motion: the empty chariot hits the water in a burst of white spray.
sfx: a great muffled splash, crowd roar far away and slowed

frame: Lamp-lit dining room in a Greek house: a dozen men of mixed origins reclining on couches around low tables, fish grilling on a clay brazier, a large painted mixing bowl for wine, warm amber light and deep shadows
motion: A man pours a little wine onto the floor for the gods; lamp flames flicker; laughter. Slow drift.
sfx: laughter, sizzling fish, cups, several conversations

frame: Medium shot of Philon the freedman, dark oiled beard, saffron-bordered himation, raising a wine cup in lamplight with ceremony
motion: He lifts the cup high; others' cups rise into frame. Static.
sfx: cups clinking

lines.text: To our treasurer. For his honesty!
Honesty!

frame: Close-up of old Damagoras reclining late at night, lamps burning low, face half in amber light, cup in his hand, speaking quietly to the room
motion: He speaks, then slowly raises his cup. Very slow push in.
sfx: quiet room, a lamp sputtering

lines.text: Four men made the same speech in council this morning. My father died on that wall so we could sit there and argue about it.
No king's man in our harbour. [raises cup] To wasted mornings.

frame: Close-up of Timokles reclining in amber lamplight, watching his father across the room with quiet love
motion: Cups rise around him; he lifts his a beat late. Static.
sfx: murmur

lines.text: To wasted mornings.

frame: Night: a lone young man walking down the middle of a straight empty ancient Greek street between dark plastered house fronts, moonlight, a single oil lamp in one doorway
motion: He walks away from camera down the street; a dog barks off screen. Static.
sfx: footsteps, a far dog, wind

frame: Night, extreme low wide: a tiny human figure standing at the foot of an enormous smooth white marble pedestal, many times his height, lit by moonlight; at the very top edge of frame only the edge of colossal bronze toes, the rest lost in darkness and stars
motion: He stands still, looking up; stars wheel very slightly. Static.
sfx: wind moving around a huge object, deep silence

frame: Extreme close-up at night: a young man's palm flat on white marble, fingertips resting in finely carved ancient Greek letters, moonlight raking across the carving
motion: His fingertips slowly trace along the carved letters. Static.
sfx: skin on stone

lines.text: [whispering] ...the people of Dorian Rhodes raised high to heaven...

frame: Close-up of Timokles's face tilted up at night, starlight and faint moonlight, a slow private smile
motion: He smiles, eyes on something vast above. Static.
sfx: silence

frame: Dark interior at night: the dull bronze breastplate on its peg, a sliver of moonlight across it; beyond, a young man lying down on a pallet
motion: Moonlight shifts slightly on the bronze. Static.
sfx: the city breathing: dogs, far harbour, wind off the strait

frame: Wide static shot over terracotta rooftops of the ancient city in blue pre-dawn light, the sea and a far coastline beyond; the sky at top of frame just beginning to warm
motion: A faint gold glow begins at the top edge of frame and starts, very slowly, to descend. Static.
sfx: a rooster, a cistern rope creaking

text: Twenty-eight years later, an earthquake brought the Colossus down.
sub: The kings of the world sent money to raise him again. The Rhodians took it, and left him lying.

frame: Macro close-up in an archaeological trench, modern daylight: blue-gloved fingers lifting a broken terracotta amphora handle out of dry soil; the stamp on it is slightly crooked, a small radiate sun face
motion: A soft brush sweeps dust off the crooked stamp. Static macro.
sfx: brush on terracotta, distant modern wind

lines.text: [softly, as memory] Somebody always reads them.

text: More than a hundred thousand stamped Rhodian jar handles survive.
